| # Object 0x1029 error behaviour {#object-0x1029-error-behaviour-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object describes the device behavior in the event of an error, i.e. when an emergency message is generated, the device switches to the defined state.

   The value of an error class can be:

   0 = Pre - operational (only if current state is operational)

   1 = No state change

   2 = Stopped

 

  Index       0x1029
  ----------- -----------------
  Name        Error Behaviour
  Object      ARRAY
  Data Type   UNSIGNED 8
  Category    Optional

 

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- -------------------------
  Description     number of Error classes
  Default value   0x01

 

  SubIndex        1
  --------------- ---------------------
  Description     Communication Error
  Default value   0x00
